name: stay-length
title: Stay Length
description: Date range readback ("Mon 2 Nov – Sun 8 Nov · 6 nights, 7 days") that flags an end before the start, nights confused with days, a check-out that may really be the last night, and weekends or holidays that change how much leave it costs, each with a one-tap fix.

meta.summary: Reads a date range back as nights and days so bookings and leave requests aren't off by one.
catches: Nights versus days confusion against the expected count
A check-out date entered as the last night
Weekend days and holidays inside the range (for leave)
limits: Works on calendar dates only, never times
Holidays are yours to pass; weekend days default to Saturday–Sunday unless you set weekend
a11y: Start and end inputs have <label>s; aria-invalid on errors
Readback in a polite live region via aria-describedby; errors use role=alert
Fix and keep are labelled buttons
